4.speaker: Hugo Toras
4.text: "It was indeed, my nephew. My compliments to the chefs."

12.speaker: Rico Toras
12.text: "The stereotypes are true. You people really do know how to entertain."

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: Hugo shot him a look of admonishment.

14.speaker: Hubertus Toras
14.text: "You and your... special friend... must have worked very hard to make this night happen."

18.speaker: Player_Romus
18.text: "All right. Let's talk about the elephant in the room."

20.speaker: Hubertus Toras
20.text: "The whole of Valenqiris is still in an uproar after your decriminalization of homosexuality. And now, the news that you yourself are... are..."

24.speaker: Hubertus Toras
24.text: "It took months to calm the uproar that your decriminalization of homosexuality caused in Valenqiris. And now, the news that you yourself are... are..."

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "There are more pressing matters than my personal life, gentlemen. We've got to deal with these protests."

29.speaker: Hubertus Toras
29.text: "Your Majesty, have you entertained the idea that the protests and your personal life may be connected?"

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "All positive societal changes are met with resistance at first. In time, relationships like mine will be considered completely normal, and bigots like you the anomaly."

31.speaker: Player_Romus
31.text: "By changing that law, I freed thousands from having to live in fear. Myself included."

35.speaker: Player_Romus
35.text: "Enough with the melodrama, Hubertus. For all I know, this is just a phase."

36.speaker: Player_Romus
36.text: "Go on, say it. Queer. Degenerate. Light in the loafers."

37.speaker: Narrator
37.text: My uncle spoke without looking me in the eye.

44.speaker: Hubertus Toras
44.text: "And the news of a new Toras heir? The icing on the proverbial cake."
44.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == true) == false)

45.speaker: Rico Toras
45.text: "And the news of a new Toras heir? The sprinkles on the proverbial sundae."
45.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == true)

47.speaker: Hubertus Toras
47.text: "And the portrait of the Queen Mother? The talk of the night."
47.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_TalkWithTitus_PortraitTalk_VisionMonarchy"] == true)

51.speaker: Hubertus Toras
51.text: "And the portrait of the Queen Mother? So very interesting."
51.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_TalkWithTitus_PortraitTalk_VisionMonarchy"] == true) == false)

53.speaker: Hugo Toras
53.text: "A respected monarch knows when to keep his private life private. I do wish you had exercised more discretion, Romus."

55.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
55.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_KeepsLastName"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false

57.speaker: Hugo Toras
57.text: "At the very least, the Toras bloodline will continue."
57.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_KeepsLastName"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false

58.text: "I fear this revelation will spell the end of the Toras bloodline."
58.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_KeepsLastName"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == false) == false

59.speaker: Player_Romus
59.text: "The Toras bloodline will end tomorrow if the protest movement gets its way. Tell me, do I have our house's support against the uprising or not?"

63.speaker: Hubertus Toras
63.text: "Valenqiris will fight for the Crown, Your Majesty."

64.speaker: Hubertus Toras
64.text: "But only if you promise that you will restore dignity and integrity to the monarchy."

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "I cannot restore it if it never went away in the first place."

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "We are under attack. Who cares about integrity at a time like this?"

69.speaker: Hugo Toras
69.text: "Our kingdom will not survive unless you abdicate."

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "Why, thank you. Pabel and I couldn't be prouder of how it all turned out."

71.speaker: Narrator
71.text: Hugo exhaled and shook his head sadly.

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: "I know what you think of me and Pabel. But as your monarch and your blood kin, I ask for your acceptance."

73.speaker: Hubertus Toras
73.text: "Your Majesty... House Toras cannot affirm this."

74.speaker: Narrator
74.text: Hugo exhaled and shook his head sadly.

75.speaker: Hubertus Toras
75.text: "Your Majesty... I cannot let your unnatural lifestyle go unremarked upon."

76.speaker: Player_Romus
76.text: "You're the father of a common criminal, Hugo. You don't get to judge me."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "Indeed. I will be relegated to the back of history books while the dynasty created by Ricardus and Vina lives on."

84.speaker: Player_Romus
84.text: "Indeed. I will be relegated to the back of history books while Vina shapes Rizia's future."

85.speaker: Player_Romus
85.text: "Nonsense. My daughter will return to Rizia, and when she does, she will be my rightful successor."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "Nonsense. My daughter is still a Toras, even if her name says otherwise."

90.speaker: Narrator
90.text: Outrage flashed across Hugo's face, quickly replaced by a look of resignation.

91.speaker: Hugo Toras
91.text: "Yes... you're right. This is what our once-great house has come to."

92.speaker: Rico Toras
92.text: "My dear cousin, you must admit that between yourself and tonight's guest of honor, this particular branch of our family tree has begun to look rather blighted."

97.speaker: Rico Toras
97.text: "A lovely vision, my cousin. Let's hope it comes to pass."

98.speaker: Player_Romus
98.text: "I couldn't give a damn about the Toras bloodline. I am concerned with the future of our country, not the future of the throne."

99.speaker: Hubertus Toras
99.text: "I may no longer rule Valenqiris. But I know the people of our province long for dignity and integrity to be restored to the monarchy after two generations of scandal."

103.speaker: Rico Toras
103.text: "Three, if you count Her Highness the runaway bride."

107.speaker: Hubertus Toras
107.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.VinaEscape_BlameGoldenGuard"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true) == false)

108.speaker: Player_Romus
108.text: "My mother told me something along the same lines. She advised me to abdicate, in fact."

112.speaker: Hubertus Toras
112.text: "The people of Valenqiris long for dignity and integrity to be restored to the monarchy after two generations of scandal."

114.speaker: Hubertus Toras
114.text: "Especially in our home province, Your Majesty."

115.speaker: Hugo Toras
115.text: "Romus, the stability and continuity of the monarchy is what ensures the future of the country. They are inextricably intertwined."

117.speaker: Hugo Toras
117.text: "Do you understand what that means, Romus?"

118.speaker: Player_Romus
118.text: "Not this again. My mother wants the exact same thing."

119.speaker: Hugo Toras
119.text: "Then Madam Estela is wiser than I thought."

120.speaker: Player_Romus
120.text: "Your insolence is unbelievable. I will reign until I'm dead."

121.speaker: Hubertus Toras
121.text: "Your Majesty, the Valenqiris nobility is willing to dedicate their considerable resources toward shutting down the rebellion."

122.speaker: Hubertus Toras
122.text: "But only if we can guarantee a return to the stability of years past. And an end to the past two generations of scandal."

123.speaker: Rico Toras
123.text: "Three, if you count Her Highness the runaway bride."

127.speaker: Hubertus Toras
127.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.VinaEscape_BlameGoldenGuard"] == false)

132.speaker: Player_Romus
132.text: "Hubertus. Is that really what you are asking of me?"

134.speaker: Player_Romus
134.text: "You are taking too dim a view of the Valenqirians. When called upon, they will rise to defend their King, no matter whom he loves."

136.speaker: Hugo Toras
136.text: "You don't have to announce it to the public right away. We have a war to win, after all."
136.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.VinaEscape_BlameGoldenGuard"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true)

140.speaker: Hugo Toras
140.text: "You don't have to announce it to the public right away."
140.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.VinaEscape_BlameGoldenGuard"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false)

141.speaker: Hugo Toras
141.text: "But it must happen sooner, rather than later."

145.speaker: Player_Romus
145.text: "I already have House Azaro and House Sazon on my side. I don't need Valenqiris."

146.speaker: Player_Romus
146.text: "I would rather hand over the crown to my family than to the revolutionaries. I will do as you ask." [Abdication Promise]

147.speaker: Player_Romus
147.text: "I will abdicate. But I'm doing it for Mother, not for you." [Abdication Promise]

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "If preserving the monarchy means preserving a legacy of bigotry, then the revolutionaries deserve to win."

149.speaker: Player_Romus
149.text: "This is preposterous. You are my subjects and my blood kin. You must come to my defense unconditionally."

154.speaker: Player_Romus
154.text: "I want the Duchess of Valeniqiris herself to weigh in on this. Where is Vina?"

157.speaker: Vina Toras
157.text: "I've heard just enough to know what's going on. And I'm staying out of this."

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "Vina. I am your father and your king. You will marshall Valenqiris' strength and help Rizia immediately."

159.speaker: Player_Romus
159.text: "Do you realize that you won't inherit the throne if the revolutionaries succeed?"

160.speaker: Player_Romus
160.text: "They want me to abdicate, just because of who I am. Doesn't that strike you as unfair?"

161.speaker: Vina Toras
161.text: "If taking the throne means suppressing the voice of the people, then I don't want it anymore."

162.speaker: Vina Toras
162.text: "If Hubertus takes it upon himself to do so, I will not get in his way. But I will not act to suppress the voice of the people."

166.speaker: Vina Toras
166.text: "What's unfair is suppressing the voice of the people when they are crying out for change."

167.speaker: Vina Toras
167.text: "You can fight to your heart's content. But if you ask me, we deserve whatever's coming to us."

171.speaker: Rico Toras
171.text: "My wife, gentlemen. Talk about a royal pain."

175.speaker: Rico Toras
175.text: "Su Omina will be on our side as well."

178.speaker: Narrator
178.text: My relatives sighed in obvious relief.

180.speaker: Hubertus Toras
180.text: "Forgive me, Your Majesty. I wish we could be of more assistance."

182.speaker: Hugo Toras
182.text: "I'll reach out to the rest of House Toras at once. Hubertus, I'm counting on you to marshall the Valenqiris nobility."
182.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Toras_TaxesAgreedOn"] == true) == false)

189.speaker: Hugo Toras
189.text: "Hubertus, I'm counting on you to gather support from House Toras and the Valenqiris nobility."
189.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Hugo_Resigned"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Toras_TaxesAgreedOn"] == true) == false)

193.speaker: Player_Romus
193.text: "I don't care what Vina says. I will abdicate if it means calming the rebellion and restoring the monarchy." [Abdication Promise]

194.speaker: Vina Toras
194.text: "If you'll excuse me, I'm going to get a drink."

195.speaker: Narrator
195.text: She turned her back swiftly and walked away.

197.speaker: Narrator
197.text: Hugo and Hubertus gave each other dubious looks, then turned toward me.

201.speaker: Player_Romus
201.text: "I will respect Vina's wishes. I forbid Valenqiris from entering this fight."

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "My decision is the same. Despite pressure from the revolutionaries and dissent within my own house, I will fight on. Alone, if need be."

203.speaker: Player_Romus
203.text: "What would you all have me do?"

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "My mother's common birth and my orientation are not 'scandals.' They're a part of our identity."

206.speaker: Narrator
206.text: Hugo and Hubertus looked at each other. There was a long silence.

207.speaker: Hugo Toras
207.text: "I trust you to do right by our house, Romus."

208.speaker: Player_Romus
208.text: "I am done talking about this. You will accept my relationship with Pabel, or face the consequences."

212.speaker: Narrator
212.text: My relatives looked at each other. There was a long silence.

213.speaker: Narrator
213.text: My relatives looked at each other. After a long silence, Hugo nodded.

215.speaker: Hugo Toras
215.text: "We will support you, Romus. But you'll understand that we can't be happy about it."

216.speaker: Hubertus Toras
216.text: "Forgive us for stepping out of line."

217.speaker: Hubertus Toras
217.text: "I will do my best to promote tolerance in Valenqiris, Your Majesty."

218.speaker: Player_Romus
218.text: "Short of handing over the crown, isn't there anything I can do that would redeem me in your eyes?"

219.speaker: Player_Romus
219.text: "I understand what you're saying. I will think very carefully about how my actions impact the future of the Rizian throne and the reputation of House Toras."

224.speaker: Narrator
224.text: Rico bowed a little too deeply.

228.speaker: Player_Romus
228.text: "The Rizian monarchy needs to enter the modern age. This revelation is only the beginning."

233.speaker: Player_Romus
233.text: "I don't have much time to waste, gentlemen. I want to know whether I can count on Valenqiris' support against the current unrest."

237.text: "I've heard news of protests in Valenqiris. What's going on?"

239.speaker: Hubertus Toras
239.text: "Why, Your Majesty. You can always count on the nobility of our province to assist the crown in whatever way it can."

244.speaker: Hubertus Toras
244.text: "However, due to the crippling taxes they now have to pay on their estates, I cannot guarantee that they will be of much use in this fight."

246.speaker: Hubertus Toras
246.text: "I would humbly ask you to repeal that tax, ensuring future prosperity for Valenqiris landowners."

247.speaker: Player_Romus
247.text: "That's all you want? It's a deal." [Revert Landowner Tax Decree]

254.speaker: Hubertus Toras
254.text: "I would humbly ask you to repeal that tax, ensuring future prosperity for the noble families of Valenqiris and their heirs."
254.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_LandOwnersTax"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_EnactInheritanceTax"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_EnactInheritanceTax"] == true)

255.speaker: Hubertus Toras
255.text: "I would humbly ask you to repeal the taxes you instituted, ensuring future prosperity for the noble landowners of Valenqiris and their heirs."

256.speaker: Player_Romus
256.text: "That's all you want? Done." [Revert Inheritance and Landowner Tax Decrees]

257.speaker: Player_Romus
257.text: "That's all you want? Done." [Revert Inheritance Tax Decree]

258.speaker: Player_Romus
258.text: "Your Grace, the reason people are rioting is because they believe the Crown favors the nobility over commoners. Do you want me to prove them right?"

259.speaker: Hubertus Toras
259.text: "The commoners hardly even pay taxes, Your Majesty. What you're demanding of the nobility is simply punitive."

260.speaker: Player_Romus
260.text: "I cannot go back on my decrees. What's done is done."

261.speaker: Hugo Toras
261.text: "I have helped you change the law plenty of times, Your Majesty. You can change it again."

262.speaker: Narrator
262.text: Hubertus reached out excitedly to shake my hand.

263.speaker: Hubertus Toras

264.speaker: Hubertus Toras
264.text: "Now and forever, the flag of House Toras shall fly over Rizia."

265.text: After a look from Hugo, he withdrew it.

266.speaker: Hubertus Toras
266.text: "There are many in Valenqiris who still disagree with what they see as the smearing of Ricardus Toras' good name."

270.speaker: Hubertus Toras
270.text: "Arrange his full pardon and release, and I will see what I can do."

272.speaker: Hugo Toras
272.text: "My son has disgraced himself as well as our house. But I still believe he deserves another chance."

273.speaker: Hugo Toras
273.text: "My son has disgraced himself as well as our house. But I know he will shine if given the opportunity."

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "If that is what it takes, then I hereby grant Ricardus a full pardon."

275.speaker: Hugo Toras
275.text: "You need not restore him to his prior position. But he cannot spend the rest of his life in prison, Romus."

276.speaker: Hugo Toras
276.text: "Give him the police chief position in Porte Drazon, Your Majesty. I promise he will not disappoint you again."

280.speaker: Player_Romus
280.text: "My mind is made up. The nobles have enough resources. Hubertus, I order you to command them to take up arms against the traitors."

281.speaker: Player_Romus
281.text: "Fine. I will grant your request immediately. The nobility will get their tax breaks."

282.speaker: Player_Romus
282.text: "No, the revolutionaries are right. A country's laws should not be dictated by its wealthiest and most privileged of citizens."

287.speaker: Player_Romus
287.text: "This isn't even your decision to make. Where is the Duchess of Valenqiris?"

289.speaker: Player_Romus
289.text: "Our relatives won't help us unless I reinstate their tax breaks. Doesn't that strike you as unfair?"

706.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_ProvincialTax_ValenqirisLowered"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_AncientRezenidCityRestoration_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_ConstructValenqirHeavyIndustrialPark_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_ConstructTopesConsumerIndustry_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_DecriminalizeHomosexuality"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_GRACEMember"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Toras_Pabel"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true)

712.speaker: Narrator
712.text: My uncle and cousin exchanged glances.

713.speaker: Hubertus Toras
713.text: "They still resent the massive sum they had to pay the Crown simply for owning land."
713.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_LandOwnersTax"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_EnactInheritanceTax"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_EnactInheritanceTax"] == true) == false)

720.speaker: Hubertus Toras
720.text: "They fear for the future prosperity of their sons and daughters."
720.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_LandOwnersTax"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_EnactInheritanceTax"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_EnactInheritanceTax"] == true)

721.speaker: Hubertus Toras
721.text: "They fear for the future prosperity of their sons and daughters, and resent the massive sum they had to pay simply because they owned land."

722.speaker: Hubertus Toras
722.text: "Could you, in all your generosity, consider repealing those taxes?"

723.speaker: Hubertus Toras
723.text: "Could you, in all your generosity, consider repealing your tax on inheritances?"

724.speaker: Hubertus Toras
724.text: "Could you, in all your generosity, consider returning that payment?"

725.speaker: Player_Romus
725.text: "You've caught me in a good mood. I shall grant your request." [Repeal Landowner and Inheritance Tax]

726.speaker: Player_Romus
726.text: "You've caught me in a good mood. I shall grant your request." [Repeal Inheritance Tax]
726.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_LandOwnersTax"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_EnactInheritanceTax"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_EnactInheritanceTax"] == true)

727.speaker: Player_Romus
727.text: "You've caught me in a good mood. I shall grant your request." [Repeal Landowner Tax]

728.speaker: Player_Romus
728.text: "Vina? How do you feel about this idea?"

733.speaker: Player_Romus
733.text: "So you are saying that the people of Valenqiris no longer wish to support the Crown financially."

734.speaker: Vina Toras
734.text: "I think you were right to implement those taxes, Father."

738.speaker: Vina Toras
738.text: "But you haven't been to Valenqiris in a while. You haven't witnessed the tension rising."

739.speaker: Vina Toras
739.text: "Our house should learn that noble riches are meant to be shared, not hoarded."

740.speaker: Hubertus Toras
740.text: "No, no. But they feel they are being punished simply for being high-born."

744.speaker: Hubertus Toras
744.text: "Thank you so much, Your Majesty! We will be celebrating in your name."

745.speaker: Hugo Toras
745.text: "Our house is full of philanthropists. They share their wealth willingly, not when it is pried from their hands."

746.speaker: Hugo Toras
746.text: "It is not only about the lost finances. They are losing trust in their king."

755.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
755.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == false

756.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
756.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == false) == false

761.speaker: Narrator
761.text: Hugo gave him a stern look.

762.speaker: Hubertus Toras
762.text: "Truth be told, I've received a great many complaints of late. Particularly from nobles."

765.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
765.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_ElectoralReform"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true) == false

766.speaker: Hubertus Toras
766.text: "Deprived of their positions in the House of Delegates, they have no other outlet for their concerns."
766.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_ElectoralReform"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false)

770.speaker: Vina Toras
770.text: "They claim they are no longer being listened to after losing their positions in the House of Delegates."
770.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_ElectoralReform"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true)

774.speaker: Vina Toras
774.text: "Before the news about Mr. Adria, the nobles of Valenqiris were already beginning to waver in their support of the Crown."

778.speaker: Vina Toras
778.text: "I'm sure you know this, Father, but the nobles of Valenqiris have begun to waver in their support of the Crown."

779.speaker: Narrator
779.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == false

780.speaker: Hubertus Toras
780.text: "There are many in Valenqiris who still disagree with what they see as the smearing of Ricardus Toras' good name."

784.speaker: Hubertus Toras
784.text: "Arrange his full pardon and release, and they will be most grateful. We all will."

786.speaker: Hugo Toras
786.text: "My son has disgraced himself as well as our house. But I still believe he deserves another chance."

787.speaker: Hugo Toras
787.text: "My son has disgraced himself as well as our house. But I know he will shine if given the opportunity."

788.speaker: Player_Romus
788.text: "I hear your request. And I hereby grant Ricardus a full pardon."

789.speaker: Hugo Toras
789.text: "You need not restore him to his prior position. But he cannot spend the rest of his life in prison, Romus."

790.speaker: Hugo Toras
790.text: "Give him the police chief position in Porte Drazon, Your Majesty. I promise he will not disappoint you again."

791.speaker: Player_Romus
791.text: "Do you truly think reinstating Ricardus' reputation would be good for the province, Vina?"

792.speaker: Narrator
792.text: My uncle's eyes filled with tears.

803.speaker: Player_Romus
803.text: "Ricardus is a failure in every aspect. And Rizia is not a kingdom that rewards failures."

804.speaker: Hubertus Toras
804.text: "It would be most kind of you to ease their minds."

808.speaker: Player_Romus
808.text: "I don't care about 'easing their minds'. Nobody should be immune from the Crown's justice, not even the King's closest of kin."

809.speaker: Hugo Toras
809.text: "I understand completely Your Majesty. And yet..."

810.speaker: Narrator
810.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true)

811.speaker: Player_Romus
811.text: "I hear your request. Hugo, consider your son promoted."

812.speaker: Player_Romus
812.text: "Is there nothing else I can do instead?"

813.speaker: Player_Romus
813.text: "My answer is still no. I cannot warp the law to serve my cousin."

814.speaker: Player_Romus
814.text: "My answer is still no. I cannot give your son a government position he doesn't deserve."

819.speaker: Hubertus Toras
819.text: "Ricardus is a nuisance, I know. But the others in our house are worried about the implications of the King punishing such a high-ranking member of his own family."

826.speaker: Hugo Toras
826.text: "I don't understand. Ricardus was long ago proven innocent!"

830.speaker: Narrator
830.text: My uncle's eyes filled with tears.

832.speaker: Vina Toras
832.text: "And I suppose it would be one less scandal."

833.speaker: Player_Romus
833.text: "Still, I can't just snap my fingers and release him. There are procedures to be followed, you know."

834.speaker: Hugo Toras
834.text: "He's your cousin, Romus. My only son."

838.speaker: Vina Toras
838.text: "But I've been hearing calls for his release since he was proven innocent in the Wehlen affair."

839.speaker: Vina Toras
839.text: "I'm no great admirer of Cousin Rico, myself."

840.speaker: Vina Toras
840.text: "But he does command a following in Valenqiris."

851.speaker: Hubertus Toras
851.text: "I am only doing what my King commands, Your Majesty."

852.speaker: Vina Toras
852.text: "If you'll excuse me, I'm going to check in on Grandmother. The last time I saw her, she was on her third martini."
852.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_EnactInheritanceTax"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_LandOwnersTax"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Deposed"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_PoliceChief_PorteDrazon"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false)

856.speaker: Player_Romus
856.text: "Which means by now, she's on the floor."

857.speaker: Narrator
857.text: Vina looked uneasily at Hubertus and Hugo.

862.speaker: Vina Toras
862.text: "It's not very popular, to say the least."

863.speaker: Hubertus Toras
863.text: "It's not very popular, to say the least."

864.speaker: Vina Toras
864.text: "The RPP has held rallies in the major cities, but attendance has been low."

866.speaker: Hubertus Toras
866.text: "The RPP has held rallies in some of the major cities. Attendance was pitiful."

867.speaker: Player_Romus
867.text: "Even a few supporters can make a big impact. In time, the whole of the province will be swayed."

868.speaker: Vina Toras
868.text: "Though I wonder if commoners are being pressured into staying home."

869.speaker: Player_Romus
869.text: "I knew the threat of reform was overblown. A handful of voices making a big ado about nothing."

870.speaker: Player_Romus
870.text: "Still, we shouldn't underestimate the reformists' reach. I hope you're keeping close watch on things."

871.speaker: Hubertus Toras
871.text: "You say that as if it were a good thing, Your Majesty..."

873.speaker: Hugo Toras
873.text: "A small flame can still spread if carefully tended. The provincial leadership must monitor these protests closely."

874.speaker: Hugo Toras
874.text: "Agreed. A small flame can still spread if carefully tended."

876.speaker: Player_Romus
876.text: "I've got to go talk to my other guests. But thank you for your feedback."
876.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Law_ProvincialTax_ValenqirisLowered"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_AncientRezenidCityRestoration_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_ConstructValenqirHeavyIndustrialPark_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_ConstructTopesConsumerIndustry_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Welfare_DecriminalizeHomosexuality"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_GRACEMember"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_Default_Toras_Pabel"] == true) == false)

882.speaker: Narrator
882.text: I left my relatives and surveyed the rest of the room.

885.speaker: Player_Romus
885.text: "For your grandmother, that's a light aperitif."

886.speaker: Player_Romus
886.text: "Such vices can no longer be tolerated in the new Rizia."

887.speaker: Player_Romus
887.text: "Already? I've got some catching up to do."

895.speaker: Vina Toras
895.text: "I'm not going to be the one to tell her that."

896.speaker: Vina Toras
896.text: "She's 75 years old. She can't keep up her old habits forever."

903.speaker: Hubertus Toras
903.text: "I thank you nonetheless for your willingness to hear our request, Your Majesty."

904.speaker: Vina Toras
904.text: "They'll be thrilled to hear this in Monqiz."

905.speaker: Hubertus Toras
905.text: "Don't despair, Hugo. The King will forgive Rico in time."

914.speaker: Vina Toras
914.text: "Yes, it's a boon to the province."

915.speaker: Player_Romus
915.text: "The Queen Mother will be fine. You don't need to babysit her."

916.speaker: Hubertus Toras
916.text: "Very good, Your Majesty. I hope the rest of your evening is thenthational."

920.speaker: Narrator
920.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true)

921.speaker: Narrator
921.text: He looked across the room at Lucita and the other Azaros.

923.speaker: Hugo Toras
923.text: "Enjoy the gathering. Who knows the next time all of us will be together again?"
923.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Rico_Extradited"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true) == false)

924.speaker: Hugo Toras
924.text: "You and Queen Consort Lucita have my sincerest congratulations."

925.speaker: Hugo Toras
925.text: "And I must say, I hope the new heir is a boy. It would give me great relief to know that House Toras will keep the throne for another generation."

932.speaker: Hugo Toras
932.text: "And I must say, I hope the new heir is a boy. It would lighten the heartache of Vina's absence to know that House Toras will keep the throne for another generation."

933.speaker: Hugo Toras
933.text: "If your new heir is a boy, you will have a difficult decision ahead of you."

937.speaker: Hugo Toras
937.text: "I hope that you will remember all of the reasons I advocated for the marriage between my son and your daughter."

938.speaker: Player_Romus
938.text: "Yes, I too am praying we'll be blessed with a son."

939.speaker: Player_Romus
939.text: "Vina has wanted to be Queen since she was a little girl. I don't want to break her heart."

944.speaker: Player_Romus
944.text: "I hope so too. I've always wanted a son."

946.speaker: Player_Romus
946.text: "No matter what happens, House Toras will hold the throne."

947.speaker: Player_Romus
947.text: "It strikes me as unfair that Vina would lose her inheritance simply for the crime of being born female."

948.speaker: Hugo Toras
948.text: "It is royal tradition, Romus. Fairness doesn't matter."

949.speaker: Hugo Toras
949.text: "It is royal tradition, Romus. She must understand that."

953.speaker: Player_Romus
953.text: "I have already promised House Azaro this. Lucita's prince will be Rizia's future king."

954.speaker: Hugo Toras
954.text: "I only pray that the rest of the Azaros will still know their place."

955.speaker: Hugo Toras
955.text: "You will have to watch the other Azaros closely, though. A claim to the throne will embolden them."

956.speaker: Hugo Toras
956.text: "We've stayed in power for this long. Fate will smile upon us."

960.speaker: Player_Romus
960.text: "Any son of mine will be Rizia's future king. I promised this to the Azaros already."

961.speaker: Player_Romus
961.text: "Any son of mine will be Rizia's future king."

962.speaker: Player_Romus
962.text: "Vina has wanted to be queen since she was a little girl. I won't take that away from her."

964.speaker: Narrator
964.text: Hugo gave a nod of understanding.

965.speaker: Hugo Toras
965.text: "Then for the sake of our house, I hope you'll have a daughter."

969.speaker: Hugo Toras
969.text: "The Azaros have been our allies for a long time. But you should be wary of granting them so much power."

970.speaker: Player_Romus
970.text: "It strikes me as unfair that Vina would lose her inheritance simply for the crime of being born female."

971.speaker: Hugo Toras
971.text: "It is royal tradition, Romus. Fairness doesn't matter. But exceptions are not unheard of."

976.speaker: Rico Toras
976.text: "Come on, Father. You've talked His Majesty's ear off for long enough."

978.speaker: Hubertus Toras
978.text: "Come, Your Grace. His Majesty has many other people to talk to tonight."

986.speaker: Hubertus Toras
986.text: "I confess I almost didn't join for tonight's celebrations, so nervous was I about leaving my palace."

987.speaker: Vina Toras
987.text: "I practically had to drag Cousin Hubertus here."

989.speaker: Hubertus Toras
989.text: "I know the officials are doing their best, but the revolutionaries... there's just too many of them."

993.speaker: Hubertus Toras
993.text: "Their ingratitude is unbelievable, Your Majesty. After all the Crown has given them."

1000.speaker: Vina Toras
1000.text: "They were given everything except for what they truly wanted. Freedom."

1001.speaker: Rico Toras
1001.text: "All of Su Omina's efforts have been useless against these barbarians."

1008.speaker: Vina Toras
1008.text: "We should have known that using force would never work."
1008.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true)

1009.speaker: Vina Toras
1009.text: "I still can't believe you arrested their leader, Father."

1017.speaker: Hubertus Toras
1017.text: "I was hoping they'd quiet down with their leader out of the picture. Alas, the opposite seems to be happening."
1017.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Arrested"] == true)

1018.speaker: Player_Romus
1018.text: "Let them throw their tantrum. They will quiet down in due time."
1018.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Arrested"] == true) == false)

1020.speaker: Player_Romus
1020.text: "I take the nobility's peace of mind seriously. Tell your constituents their King will protect them."
1020.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Arrested"] == true) == false)

1021.speaker: Player_Romus
1021.text: "I am counting on you and the rest of the other provincial leadership to preserve order."
1021.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Arrested"] == true) == false)

1023.speaker: Player_Romus
1023.text: "I've tried everything I possibly could. I'm afraid it's out of my hands now."
1023.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Rico"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Arrested"] == true) == false)

1031.speaker: Vina Toras
1031.text: "Time was that the Rizian people trusted House Toras to provide for them. We've failed them for the last time."

1032.speaker: Vina Toras
1032.text: "You and Cousin Hubertus can 'preserve order' to your heart's content. But I won't play a part in it."

1033.speaker: Hubertus Toras
1033.text: "We will try our best, Your Majesty."

1037.speaker: Vina Toras
1037.text: "This is more than just a tantrum."

1042.speaker: Vina Toras
1042.text: "And the ordinary people crying out to be heard? What do I tell them?"

1047.speaker: Hubertus Toras
1047.text: "I am doing what I can to keep our province together, Your Majesty."

1051.speaker: Player_Romus
1051.text: "Hubertus, Hugo... are you with me, at least?"

1055.speaker: Player_Romus
1055.text: "Rico, can you talk some sense into your wife?"

1057.speaker: Player_Romus
1057.text: "I am doing more for the Rizian people than you know. Someday, they will thank me."

1062.speaker: Hubertus Toras
1062.text: "Valenqiris will stand as a bastion of royal values. Until the very end."

1065.speaker: Hubertus Toras
1065.text: "The rest of Valenqiris may be wavering in its support for the Crown. But I am still on your side."

1067.speaker: Narrator
1067.text: Hugo and Hubertus exchanged wary glances.

1071.speaker: Player_Romus
1071.text: "We've brought God into their lives. How can you say we've failed them?"

1072.speaker: Hubertus Toras
1072.text: "Your great efforts on behalf of the Wruhecist community have not gone unseen."

1073.speaker: Player_Romus
1073.text: "I have failed no one. I command you to do your duty as Duchess and take a stand against what's happening."

1074.speaker: Narrator
1074.text: Vina looked as if she was going to be sick.

1077.speaker: Narrator
1077.text: She walked away with quick steps.

1078.speaker: Hugo Toras
1078.text: "Nothing is more important to this house. To me."

1080.speaker: Player_Romus
1080.text: "My final answer is no. Sorry to disappoint you."
